start_here: Say to your AI: "Run the tests of the commit that just landed." It runs tool:run-the-tests-of-what-landed.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: its findings are calendar_tasks rows in the person's database.
instructions: 1. Keep the checkout of the Rust engine and its module map (read-data/module-map.json) on the computer that runs the tool.
2. Run the tool with the commit before the landing and the landed commit.
3. Read the answer: status pass, fail, unknown or not-mapped, and each filter's seconds. A cap-out is unknown, which is not a pass.
4. Findings for red filters go to the lane named in the commit's Lane trailer. The tool never refuses or reverts a push.

worked_examples.title: Run the module tests of the last landed commit
worked_examples.ask: Run the tests of the commit that just landed.
worked_examples.given: A landed commit C whose parent is P, and a module map with the Rust engine checkout named in read-data/module-map.json.
